description: This file defines a PHP class 'CandidateOfferDecliningAPI' inside the recruitment API namespace, which provides an API endpoint for declining a job offer for a candidate within the OrangeHRM recruitment module. It includes OpenAPI annotations for documentation and a method to retrieve the specific workflow state representing the decline action.

classes.name: CandidateOfferDecliningAPI
classes.description: API class providing functionality for declining a candidate's job offer in the recruitment workflow. Extends the AbstractCandidateActionAPI class and implements a method to return the specific workflow state constant for declining an offer.

methods.name: getResultingState
methods.description: Returns the integer constant representing the 'decline offer' state in the recruitment workflow.
